unit_of_analysis: test variant; repeated executions are used only for stability assessment

rule_coverage.note: Coverage is rule execution/classifiable output, not detection effectiveness.

DOM.note: Secondary assertion outcomes are analyzed separately from the primary rule verdicts.

AX.note: Secondary assertion outcomes are analyzed separately from the primary rule verdicts.

mcnemar_exact.note: Paired correctness uses the provisional reference only; interpretation/extension cases and unclassifiable engine results are excluded.

interpretive_and_extension_cases.note: Interpretive and extension cases (TC11-TC14) are reported separately from confirmed W3C mappings, as the proposal requires. TC08 has a NOT_TESTABLE reference and is a coverage gap for both engines.

limitations: Expected outcomes are provisional and have not received independent manual/screen-reader review.
Precision, recall, F1, accuracy, McNemar, and kappa are reference comparisons, not validated conformance accuracy.
NOT_TESTABLE and INAPPLICABLE are never recoded as PASS.
Rules are tailored to these purpose-built fixtures; results do not estimate general-purpose tool performance.
Fresh-context repeats are largely deterministic and assess implementation stability, not robustness or generalisability.
Direct URL and in-app navigation are repeated conditions on the same variants, not independent samples.
Small sample size and controlled fixtures do not establish general superiority.
